message: Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul && git log --oneline -10 2>/dev/null && echo "---" && git diff HEAD~1 HEAD -- xpath.c 2>/dev/null | head -100

message.content:
Now I understand the vulnerability. The `xmlXPathGetElementsByIds` function calls `xmlGetID(doc, ID)` which returns an attribute. Then it accesses `attr->parent` to get the element. The issue is that during XInclude processing or xmlTextReader, the node/attribute may have been freed, leading to a use-after-free when `xmlXPathNodeSetAdd` accesses `val->type` (which reads freed memory).

Let me look at the git history to understand what the fix was, and check the test harness:
